│ Initiatives  >  Improve shared-context proje  >  pi-shared-context-ux-01-proj  >  Description                                     │
│> Select shared-context projects through interactive breadcrumbs · Description                                                     │
│ ## What to build                                                                                                                  │
Wa│ Add the Projects view to the shared-context modal. Users open this view through a focusable, clickable Projects breadcrumb. Users │
'/│ select a project and browse its existing tracker and Files workspace.                                                             │
───│ Reuse shared-context enumeration and route resolution. Include the current project. Deduplicate entries by canonical identity. Do │────
Up│ not scan unrelated repositories or add another project registry.                                                                  │
Ne│                                                                                                                                   │
───│ Establish the breadcrumb and focus contract for later tracker screens. The current command still opens the current project.       │────
│ Selecting another project changes only the modal context.                                                                         │
❯  │ ## Acceptance criteria                                                                                                            │
◑ │ 1. The project list displays a name and origin or stable identity for each project. Equal repository names remain distinguishable.│
│ 2. Keyboard focus reaches the Projects breadcrumb. Enter activates it. A mouse click activates the same control.                  │
│ 3. Selecting a project resolves its routes before record access. The selected project owns tracker reads, Files reads, and action │
│ targets.                                                                                                                          │
│ 4. The header displays Shared or Repo from the selected alignment route. The indicator is read-only.                              │
│ 5. Project selection does not change the active Pi session directory or system instructions.                                      │
│ 6. Returning to a project restores its navigation, selection, and scroll position. Each workspace retains independent state.      │
│ 7. Project changes dispose of old watchers and attach the correct new watchers. Old project updates do not change the selected    │
│ project view.                                                                                                                     │
│ 8. A project without a usable checkout retains readable context. Checkout-dependent actions display a clear disabled reason.      │
│ 9. No action runs against the previous project after selection changes. Existing action revalidation and fresh-chat behavior      │
│ remain intact.                                                                                                                    │
│ 10. Tab and Shift+Tab move focus forward and backward. Existing workspace number shortcuts remain unchanged.                      │
│ 11. Esc from the tracker root opens Projects. Esc from Projects closes the modal. Existing Files escape behavior remains          │
│ unchanged.                                                                                                                        │
│ 12. Empty, unreadable, and unavailable project states display distinct explanations. The current project remains reachable.       │
│ ## Out of scope                                                                                                                   │
│ Do not change tracker hierarchy in this ticket. Do not clone repositories, migrate storage, or change session instructions.       │
│ ## Specification                                                                                                                  │
│ The parent specification defines the complete product intent. This ticket implements only the approved slice.                     │
